review.notes: Four complete consistent views, bow in left hand, stone/charcoal/bronze materials; not calibrated orthographic drawings; snake count not a runtime invariant. Mesh/UV/rig and approval remain pending.
Four complete consistent views; crown, sword in right hand, broad cloak, heavy armored silhouette and no shield. Neutral colors; reference sheet, not calibrated engineering views.
Four complete views; pointed hat, beard, staff, lighter silhouette. A second imagegen pass corrected the mirrored staff grip in the fourth view. Not calibrated orthographic drawings.

Four complete views of one compact feathered harpy; two wing-arms, two taloned legs, broad silhouette, small plinth and consistent restrained palette. One design for all three instances; physical dimensions and rig remain pending.
Three full consistent views of a faceless static neutral mannequin, clear simple limbs and neutral band reserved for team color. Mesh construction still required.

Visually counted 5 columns by 6 rows: 30 cells, top 15 blue and bottom 15 red, shape-distinct border glyphs. No obstacles. Top-down modeling reference only; not a runtime camera or authoritative geometry. Zone color must remain server-driven at runtime.

Complete perspective and side views of low unobstructed rectangular tray; weathered timber rim, ragged stone underside, no tall foreground props. Footprint is a proposal; actual board geometry remains driven by S04/server.
Three complete consistent views; simple thick iron structure, small base and localized amber lamp. Use as far-corner decor; dimensions/light radius require UE validation.
Front, side, rear and perspective views of shallow low two-bay facade; no gameplay openings or tall tower. Far-edge decoration only; screen occlusion must be checked in UE.
Complete front/side/rear and extra perspective views of one low half-timber module with shuttered window and flat back; restrained stone/wood palette. Only far-edge decor; not a full building.
Multiple complete consistent views of a low stone wall with blocked arch and one squat buttress; no traversable door, no tall tower. Good large masonry shapes; UE occlusion and physical size pending.
Three consistent crate views, broad planks, simple cross brace, muted iron rivets and readable bevels; no text or extra props.
Three complete barrel views, closed broad-plank lid, two thick hoops and readable facets; subdued wood/iron, no markings.

Flat full-bleed neutral cobblestone color source, large clear stones and restrained grout. No zones or grid baked in. Seamless tiling and physically unlit albedo are not verified; UV/material baking remains required.
Uniform cool fractured slate color source with broad planes and no masonry pattern. Seam continuity and albedo de-lighting remain unverified; intended for material authoring, not certified PBR maps.
Full-bleed subdued vertical old wood grain, no plank boundaries, hardware or lighting gradient. Source suitable for further material painting; seamless repeat not verified.
Uniform flat charcoal textile without folds, seams, symbols or framing. Fine weave will need scale control and mip checks on miniature surfaces; seamless repeat unverified.
Muted warm bronze color source with sparse patina and no specular highlights or engraved details. Metallic/roughness channels and seam continuity require separate authoring and checks.
Flat charcoal iron color source, low-contrast oxidation and no highlights or rivets. Metallic/roughness values, tile edges and UV-baking are still pending.
